description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Takes a SCHEDULED post off the platform schedule and marks it cancelled (the draft stays, so it can be published again). Safe to repeat. Refused within 5 minutes of the slot, and when the platform will not remove it (some YouTube uploads). Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) and the Pro plan or higher; each publish counts against the plan's direct posts for the month. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

id.description: The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

name: cancel_scheduled_post
title: Cancel a scheduled post
